component.name: AGVPN
component.summary: Unofficial desktop client for AdGuard VPN

description.p: A native GTK 4 / libadwaita desktop app for AdGuard VPN on Linux, modelled on the official macOS app. It controls the official AdGuard VPN CLI, which is downloaded from AdGuard's GitHub releases during installation.

ul.li: One-click connect, fastest and saved locations with ping
Website exclusions: General and Selective modes, popular services, subdomains, import and export
DNS servers: default, popular (AdGuard DNS, Cloudflare, Quad9…) and custom
VPN (TUN) and SOCKS5 modes, HTTP/2 or QUIC protocol, post-quantum cryptography
Usage stats, account and subscription info, tray icon and notifications

description.p: This app is not affiliated with AdGuard. An AdGuard VPN account is required.

Нативное приложение на GTK 4 / libadwaita для AdGuard VPN в Linux по образцу официального приложения для macOS. Управляет официальным AdGuard VPN CLI, который скачивается из релизов AdGuard на GitHub при установке.
Приложение не связано с компанией AdGuard. Нужен аккаунт AdGuard VPN.
The app was rewritten in Rust: faster start-up and lower memory use. Settings, stats and the signed-in account are kept.
